segments.name: Biospecimen Marketplace
segments.description: Operates a two-sided online marketplace connecting life science researchers with healthcare providers' human biospecimens, subjects and data.
segments.evidence: We manage our business globally within one operating segment in accordance with ASC Topic 280, Segment Reporting ("ASC 280").

revenueModel.text: Researchers pay iSpecimen to buy specimens and associated data they order through the marketplace.
revenueModel.evidence: Researchers can then select the specific specimens they need for their studies, add them to a cart, request quotes, place orders, and track and manage their specimen requests and associated data across projects.
